title: Micro consensus roster and asks — short-run stakeholder pulse
content:
Purpose: quick, timeboxed ledger to capture micro-consensus across cross-functional stakeholders for the April light launch window. Use this sheet for 1) single-line asks, 2) a lightweight consensus score (0=no alignment, 5=full alignment), 3) owner/ETA and immediate blockers

Header: Stakeholder | Role | Consensus (0-5) | Ask (one-line) | Owner | ETA | Risk (L/M/H) | Quick notes / next step

1) Product Leadership | Launch sponsor | 5 | Approve route (hosted + dedicated fallback) | Ravi Shah | 2029-03-18 | L | verbally confirmed in 3/11 sync; follow up w/ prod brief
2) Platform Eng (autoscaling) | Owner: Kat Ito | 3 | Confirm burst policy for dedicated pools | Kat Ito | 2029-03-20 | M | needs capacity table; Kat asked for sample traffic profile (ticket OPS-7823)
3) Serving Runtime | Perf owner | 2 | Can we guarantee 150ms p95 on small prompt? | Ahmed Qureshi | 2029-03-19 | H | currently 180-220ms in canary; perf trade suggested: quantized variant fallback. Action: quick perf triage call 3/14
4) Observability | Logs/tracing | 4 | Add route-level latency tag + cost tag | Eleni Gomez | 2029-03-17 | L | telemetry PR open (GH#1127), waiting review
5) SRE | Runbook owner | 3 | Update runbook for dual-region failover | Tom Rivera | 2029-03-22 | M | partial draft, needs DR contact list from infra
6) Security/Compliance | Data handling | 1 | Confirm no PII will be persisted to hosted analytics | Maya Patel | 2029-03-20 | H | legal review required, asked for example payloads
7) Solutions Eng | Field enablement | 4 | Prepare two short playbooks for customers | Priya Anand | 2029-03-21 | L | can reuse existing playbook template; will adapt examples
8) GTM / Customer Success | Launch comms | 3 | Timeboxed comms plan + escalation contacts | Jonah Meyer | 2029-03-18 | M | needs exported bullet list of feature differences

Scoring rubric (quick): 0 = actively opposed / blocking; 1 = significant open blocking questions; 2 = many open risks; 3 = partial alignment with caveats; 4 = aligned pending minor clarifications; 5 = green to proceed

Open questions / blockers (top 3):
- Serving runtime: do we accept the cost uplift of keeping quantized fallback warm? (Perf owner to quantify delta by 3/15)
- Security needs example payloads. Solutions Eng to produce sanitized samples by 3/16.
- Autoscaling table: need 7-day peak distribution from product telemetry (Ravi to export and send to Kat by EOD 3/13)

Quick escalation path (if consensus <=2 on critical owner):
1) Owner-level asynchronous sync (48h) -> 2) Same-day 30m triage with Ravi + owners -> 3) Exec escal (if unresolved after 72h)

Notes to self / rough log:
- 3/11: kickoff sync, recorded (link in Confluence).
- 3/12: Maya flagged legal gating for analytics retention; added to sheet.
- 3/13: Observability PR referenced; Eleni to attach diff.

Next steps (immediate, owner -> ETA):
- Ahmed: perf triage call 3/14 10am PT (add SRE + infra) -> quantify p95 and fallback cost impact by 3/15
- Kat: autoscale table by 3/20 (Ravi to provide telemetry sample)
- Maya: legal checklist status update 3/16 (attach redlines)
- Eleni: attach telemetry PR link and why tags chosen 3/17

If you edit: change only consensus numbers and add your initials to the note line. Keep this doc as the single source for micro-asks in the short window.

Linked refs / shortcuts:
- OPS ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-7823
- Confluence brief: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PROD/Stakeholder+Mini-Pulse+Mar+2029
- Slack thread: #prod-ops (thread F93J2K4)

Unresolved / parking lot items (to move out after 3/22):
- Larger cost model for quantized fallbacks (assign to Optimize team)
- Full runbook DR exercise (schedule with SRE)

End of sheet.
